websiteFacts.claim: Brightmark assembles branded kits and ships them to individual recipients.
Brightmark sells branded drinkware, bags, tech accessories, apparel, and event merchandise.

newsletterSamples.label: Client thank-you gifts
newsletterSamples.content: A client gift does not need to be loud. It needs to be useful on an ordinary Tuesday. That is why we keep coming back to the insulated bottle. Add the recipient's name, keep the logo small, and choose a color they would have picked themselves. It feels considered without turning the gift into a billboard. Brightmark can pack each bottle in a mailer with your note and ship it directly to every recipient. You send one address list. We handle the boxes. Want to see the three bottle styles clients reorder most? Reply and I will send them over.

newsletterSamples.label: Trade show giveaways
newsletterSamples.content: People take pens because they are free. That is a pretty low bar. For your next trade show, start with what happens after the booth. A compact charger gets tossed into a travel bag. A cable organizer stays beside a laptop. A good tote makes it through the airport. That is the test we use at Brightmark: would someone still use this if the logo disappeared? We can build a short list around your audience, budget, and event date. Send us the attendee profile and we will narrow the catalog before you lose an afternoon to it.
